newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares rebound 1.68pct, seen ranging.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares rebound 1.68pct, seen ranging.

text.p: The Greek bourse rose 1.68 percent on Thursday with market watchers saying there was no specific good news to trigger this rise and unsure of where the market was headed in the short term.
"The bourse is nervous and testing the 1,250-70 level after its sharp rise in January and early February," said John Vezanis, the general manager at Midland Hellenobretanniki Mutual Funds.
He added that the government's firm stance on Greece's attempt to fulfill EU convergence requirements was very positive.
The Athens general share index closed 1.68 percent or 21.12 points higher at 1278.12 points from Wednesday's 1257.00 after opening at 1254.82.
Turnover was 11.0 billion drachmas on volume of 3.5 million shares. Advancers led decliners 147 to 67 with 33 issues unchanged on 247 traded.
Construction rose 1.73 percent and banks ended 2.33 percent higher. Investment shares firmed 1.53 percent. Industrials settled 1.47 percent higher. Small caps firmed 0.80 percent.
